name: qamaster
description: QA for your app, built from its code and a safe crawl of the running app: maps every screen (/qamaster:dsm), writes traceable test cases and Playwright-BDD or pytest scripts, publishes them to Azure DevOps Test Plans or a local file (/qamaster:publish), and runs the tests a change touches before git push (/qamaster:check). Start with /qamaster:status; reports with /qamaster:report.
